_doc: Hunters vs Farmers characters and army (docs/hvf-PLAN.md §6, §7). Read by js/sim/modes/hvf/. Speeds m/s, radius m, sight m, damage per hit. `chop` = seconds to cut one tree cell (briar: `chopBriar`). Hunter HP and damage are multiplied by the format's `hunterMult` (rules.json) and grow `perLevel` per level (levels from kills only, H3). The farmer cannot attack.
